label: Dense
description: Rich, layered wallpaper-scale coverage — hero motifs cluster tightly, minimal breathing room, built for luxury wallpaper/upholstery scale.

rules.description: A dense composition without any overlapAmount tends to show visible seams between motifs — pair with overlapMode 'natural' or 'dense'.
Dense + a high-detail motif category (e.g. botanical, mandala) can exceed the SVG Engine's hard node budget — verify with the Design Quality loop before shipping.
